h1.en: 30 MPa stays on the Diesel 50 vs Diesel 60 Concrete Pump page
h1.zh: 30 MPa仍写在柴油50和柴油60混凝土泵有何不同这一页

directAnswer.en: Diesel 50 and Diesel 60 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Both list the engine code 6105 and outlet pressure 30 MPa. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_rail.
directAnswer.zh: 柴油50和柴油60是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。两边都标出发动机代号 6105 和出口压力 30 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_rail。

body.en: Downloaded from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_rail. The image subject is Common rail. Diesel 50 and Diesel 60 are separate concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. Diesel 60 lists 144 kW, 35 m³/h, distance 150 m / 350 m and the model line Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. Theoretical output: Diesel 50 lists 30 m³/h. Diesel 60 lists 35 m³/h. Dimensions: Diesel 50 lists 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm. Diesel 60 lists 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm. These are shown entries on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump. Open /en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 50 and /en/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/ for Diesel 60. If a job needs a figure this pair does not list, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 此图下载自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_rail。画面内容是Common rail。柴油50和柴油60是河北品锦机械在邢台的两台混凝土泵。柴油60标出 144 kW、35 m³/h、距离 150 m / 350 m，型号行为柴油60 / HBT60-13.132。输送距离（水平/垂直）：柴油50标出 150 m / 450 m；柴油60标出 150 m / 350 m。整机重量：柴油50标出 3300 kg；柴油60标出 3500 kg。柴油60有、柴油50没有的行：型号行 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132。如果工况需要这对机型没有写出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

body.en: Both list the engine code 6105 and outlet pressure 30 MPa. The shared code 6105 does not make the kilowatts equal. Pumping distance (H / V): Diesel 50 lists 150 m / 450 m. Diesel 60 lists 150 m / 350 m. Main unit weight: Diesel 50 lists 3300 kg. Diesel 60 lists 3500 kg. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other. Read the kilowatt beside 6105. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei.
body.zh: 两边都标出发动机代号 6105 和出口压力 30 MPa。柴油机功率：柴油50标出 6105 / 99 kW；柴油60标出 6105 / 144 kW。液压泵：柴油50标出 Kawasaki 140；柴油60标出 Kawasaki double pump 100。同一标题下数值相同的有：最大出口压力两边都是 30 MPa；料斗容积两边都是 0.4 m³。看柴油50请打开 /zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/，看柴油60请打开 /zh/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/。

body.en: Diesel 50 lists 99 kW, 30 m³/h and distance 150 m / 450 m. Diesel engine power: Diesel 50 lists 6105 / 99 kW. Diesel 60 lists 6105 / 144 kW. Hydraulic pump: Diesel 50 lists Kawasaki 140. Diesel 60 lists Kawasaki double pump 100. The same shown value on a shared label: Max. outlet pressure is 30 MPa on both pages. Hopper capacity is 0.4 m³ on both pages. Diesel 60 lists entries that Diesel 50 does not: Model line Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. The code alone is not the power. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance.
body.zh: 柴油50标出 99 kW、30 m³/h、距离 150 m / 450 m。理论输送量：柴油50标出 30 m³/h；柴油60标出 35 m³/h。外形尺寸：柴油50标出 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm；柴油60标出 4800 × 1700 × 1700 mm。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上写出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。

question.en: Does Diesel 50 list the same diesel engine power as Diesel 60?
question.zh: 柴油50和柴油60的柴油机功率一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 50 lists 6105 / 99 kW. Diesel 60 lists 6105 / 144 kW. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_rail.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油50标出 6105 / 99 kW。柴油60标出 6105 / 144 kW。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_rail画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 50 list the same theoretical output as Diesel 60?
question.zh: 柴油50和柴油60的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 50 lists 30 m³/h. Diesel 60 lists 35 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_rail.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油50标出 30 m³/h。柴油60标出 35 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_rail画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Does Diesel 50 list the same pumping distance (h / v) as Diesel 60?
question.zh: 柴油50和柴油60的输送距离（水平/垂直）一样吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 50 lists 150 m / 450 m. Diesel 60 lists 150 m / 350 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue entries from Xingtai, and neither entry replaces the other. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_rail.
answer.zh: 不一样。柴油50标出 150 m / 450 m。柴油60标出 150 m / 350 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_rail画面里印出的数字。

question.en: Where is the model line for Diesel 60 shown?
question.zh: 柴油60的型号行标出在哪里？

answer.en: It is shown on /en/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/ as Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132. It is not shown as that label on the Diesel 50 page. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_rail.
answer.zh: 标出在 /zh/products/diesel-60-concrete-pump/，数值为 Diesel 60 / HBT60-13.132。柴油50页面没有这个标题。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Common_rail画面里印出的数字。
